0022600121.text: The Celtics, 1-1 and 8th in the East after two games, host the Bulls, who are 1-2 and 11th in the East after three, with Boston 1-0 at home and Chicago 1-1 on the road. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, and Chicago will be without Nic Claxton (hamstring) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness). The teams have not met yet this season, but Boston won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 124-105 win in Boston on February 11, 2026.
